description: A young man in a red cloak and metal chest armour stands on stone steps before a massive Egyptian temple wall covered in carved reliefs, pointing with one arm. Beside him, Roman legionaries in helmets and scale or mail armour hold shields, and one carries a tall golden eagle standard. To the left, galley ships sit moored at a dark, stormy waterfront, with shirtless men working in the foreground. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
